summary: Iteration 10 retest of the 4 requested capability areas. Backend: 16/16 new pytest cases pass (/app/backend/tests/test_iter10.py) plus a 3-run latency/repeatability test. All iteration_9 MEDIUM items verified fixed: (A) evidence-led detection — every evidence item now either carries a fig that resolves to a real /api/documents/{id}/download image (verified 200 + content-type image) or fig='' with source='Assessment / floor plan'; zero broken 'FIG nn'. (B) datasheets/parse returns count>0 with correct per-measure mapping and 422 with a meaningful detail on projects with no manufacturer datasheets. (C) 'Technical Survey' import slot present in PHOTO_DOC_TYPES and on /import; Coldrush pack.html renders 'Appendix A · Supporting Documents' with the 'Supporting Documents, Surveys & Certificates' table (Document + Type) and the TOC entry 'Supporting Documents & Datasheets'; pack.pdf 200 (%PDF, >20KB). (D) Coldrush products isolated — none of its product names appear on RTF-2026-0138 / RTF-2026-0149. Frontend: SiteConditionsPanel state syncs after re-detect, 'Reading photos…' busy label + disabled button, window.confirm before overwrite, FIG caption hidden and source label shown when there is no photo, all evidence thumbnails load (naturalWidth>0). Measure detail Specified Products render for ASHP/LOFT/SOLAR/VENT, delete button always visible (opacity 0.4), add + inline edit + remove persist via PATCH. Parse toast shows 'Parsed 17 product(s) into the design' on success and 'Could not parse datasheets — No readable datasheets found...' on 422. One genuine new defect found: parse is not idempotent and accumulates near-duplicate products.

minor.issue: NOT IDEMPOTENT — _assign_products() de-dupes on the exact tuple (product, reference), which never matches across AI wording variance, so every re-parse appends near-duplicate rows. Coldrush grew from 14 to 43 products over 5 parse runs during this test (ASHP now has 'FTC6 Standard Pre-Plumbed Cylinder' 7 times with refs 'EHPT15X/17X/21X', 'EHPT15X-UKHDW1S', …; LOFT has 4 'Universal 20k Tile Vent' and 4 Knauf rows). These duplicates also render in pack.html/pdf. Fix: tag parsed rows (e.g. source='datasheet') and REPLACE them on re-parse, keeping manual rows, plus a normalised (lower/alnum) dedupe key.

Intermittent 502 (Cloudflare 'origin returned an invalid or incomplete response') when the ~30s AI call overlaps other long requests (pack.pdf / vision detect). Reproduced twice (once in a parallel pytest run, once from the UI); 4 sequential runs afterwards all returned 200 in 27-31s. Long AI endpoints should be made async/queued or the blocking sync work (WeasyPrint, PDF rasterise) moved fully off the event loop.
Carried over from iteration_9 and still open: 36 orphan documents with project_id null/missing (of 137). Also inconsistent doc_type casing: both 'Assessment' and 'assessment' exist.

issues: No success toast after a 20-40s detect completes — the only feedback is the button reverting to 'Re-detect'. A 'Detected N conditions' toast would match the parse-datasheets pattern.

Duplicate/near-duplicate parsed rows make the table noisy (ASHP 11 rows, LOFT 15 rows for 12 datasheets) — consequence of the non-idempotent parse above; long 'reference' strings (whole Knauf product lists) overflow the REF column readability.

action_items: Make datasheet parsing idempotent: replace previously-parsed products (source tag) instead of appending, and normalise the dedupe key. Also de-duplicate the polluted Coldrush product lists (43 rows -> ~14).
Harden the slow AI endpoints against gateway 502s under concurrency (background job / streaming keepalive, or ensure no sync blocking in the event loop).
Optional: success toast after site-condition detect; clean up the 36 orphan project_id=null documents and normalise doc_type casing ('assessment' -> 'Assessment').

rca_of_the_issue: Product accumulation: parse_datasheets_endpoint calls _assign_products(), which appends any parsed record whose (product, reference) tuple is not already present. The LLM returns semantically identical products with different wording/reference formatting on each run ('EHPT15X-UKHDW1S' vs 'EHPT15X / 17X / 21X-UKHDW1S'), so the guard never fires and each parse monotonically grows measures[i].products; the design pack then renders the duplicates. Reproduction: POST /api/projects/{coldrush}/datasheets/parse 3-5 times and read measures[*].products (14 -> 43). Mitigation: persist provenance on parsed rows and replace them wholesale on re-parse, with a normalised comparison key.
